scope: Five completed Astra medium WSI conditions on four selected public sources; no new model run or score change
method: Recomputed one-to-one matches with the pinned wsi-agent-v1 scorer, compared final answers with evaluator-only references after completion, projected recorded helper crop rectangles onto reference geometry, and inspected saved command traces and answer-generation scripts. Crop containment shows an image region was generated, not that every object was consciously reviewed. Native slide reads could bypass helper ledgers.

hubmap.interpretation_boundary: Most unmatched points are not explained by duplicate matching. The 19 lower-confidence candidates account for much of the unmatched count, but reference coverage and morphology need adjudication before calling them false glomeruli.

tissue_supplied.roi3_error_mechanism: Both predicted compartment codes equal the supplied mask at the predicted point; the scorer checks the mask at the matched reference-cell center, 1.4 and 3.6 pixels away.

tiger.interpretation_boundary: The independent runs used different enlarged-tile layouts as well as different assistance. Detection changes cannot be causally assigned to the supplied tissue masks.

camelyon.direct_crop_geometry: Both unhit polygon bounds lie within the trace's page-4 lower crop (900,1550)-(3450,2800) on a 15x-downsampled pyramid page, equivalent to level-0 (13500,23250)-(51750,42000).
camelyon.interpretation_boundary: The two unhit polygons were available in a broad low-resolution crop but not revisited at detail resolution. The three outside points are unsupported by the six released Tumor polygons; their clinical truth requires independent review.

hiesd.interpretation_boundary: The answer script drew broad class-2 and class-6 polygons and never emitted classes 4 or 5. Labels outside XML-annotated regions are unscored, not known-normal false positives.
